sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Persicaria capitata is a creeping annual or perennial depending on conditions, 5–50 cm tall. It often roots at the nodes and can persist once established.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The leaves are about 1.5–6 × 0.6–3.3 cm and often bear a V-shaped mark. The rounded, pink terminal inflorescences are about 5–20 mm long. The flowers are 2–3 mm and produce a three-angled achene 1.5–2.2 mm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No safe food use was found for this species; do not assign it food uses documented for other Persicaria.
